name: Formula 1 Heineken Las Vegas Grand Prix
blurb: F1 night race weekend run on a 3.8-mile street circuit down the Las Vegas Strip, with the main grand prix held November 22, 2025.

name: Wrangler National Finals Rodeo (NFR)
blurb: The PRCA's championship rodeo runs ten nightly performances at 5:45 p.m. with a purse exceeding $17.5 million.

name: Cowboy Christmas Gift Show
blurb: The free official NFR gift show fills South Hall with 350-plus Western-lifestyle exhibitors daily from 9 a.m. to 4 p.m.

name: SRS Distribution Las Vegas Bowl
blurb: The college football bowl game, played on its first-ever New Year's Eve date, saw Utah defeat Nebraska 44-22.

name: Ethel M Chocolates' 32nd Annual Holiday Cactus Garden Lights
blurb: Over one million lights wrap hundreds of cacti and desert plants nightly from 5 p.m., with a $3 entry fee benefiting local food banks.

name: Glittering Lights at Las Vegas Motor Speedway
blurb: A 2.5-mile drive-through display of over six million lights and 750-plus exhibits, open nightly for its 25th season.

name: Magical Forest at Opportunity Village
blurb: A walkable holiday lights park with rides, mini golf, a train and Santa, opening with a tree-lighting ceremony on November 28.

name: Las Vegas Great Santa Run
blurb: The 21st annual 5K and 1-mile run sends thousands of red-suited Santas through downtown, benefiting Opportunity Village.

name: Santa's Electric Night Parade
blurb: The 57th annual lighted-float night parade winds through the historic district near Hoover Dam, starting at 4:30 p.m.

name: Las Vegas Veterans Day Parade
venue: Downtown Las Vegas (4th Street, Garces to Stewart)
blurb: The largest Veterans Day parade west of the Mississippi ran 10 a.m. to noon with roughly 150 entries and tens of thousands of spectators.

name: Dia de los Muertos Free Festival
blurb: A free City of Las Vegas Day of the Dead festival from 3 to 9 p.m. with altars, artisan vendors, food and live entertainment.

name: Dia de Muertos at Springs Preserve
blurb: A ticketed evening Day of the Dead festival with mariachis, folklorico dancers, ofrendas and artisans, 5 to 9 p.m.

name: Sparks Hometowne Christmas Tree Lighting & Parade
blurb: A tree lighting on December 5 and the 38th annual Christmas parade down Victorian Avenue on December 6, themed 'Christmas in Toyland.'

name: Holiday Lights Festival at BELIEVE Plaza
blurb: A free downtown festival with Santa, vendors and a Christmas tree lighting at 7 p.m. on December 5.

name: Leonid Meteor Shower peak
venue: Great Basin International Dark Sky Park
blurb: The Leonids peak overnight November 17-18, 2025 under a thin crescent moon, favoring dark Nevada skies away from city light.

name: Geminid Meteor Shower peak
venue: Great Basin International Dark Sky Park
blurb: The Geminids peak overnight December 13-14, 2025 at up to about 120 meteors per hour with a non-interfering waning crescent moon.

name: Death Valley '49ers Annual Encampment
venue: Stovepipe Wells Village, Death Valley National Park
blurb: A free Old West heritage gathering with historical reenactments, live music, blacksmith and Dutch oven demonstrations, a vendor show, and an art show in the desert.

name: Dia de los Muertos Procession (44th Annual)
venue: Mission District, staging on Bryant St between 19th and 22nd
blurb: A free community Day of the Dead ritual procession with Aztec dancers, lowriders, live bands, and altars winding from 22nd and Bryant down to 24th and Mission and back, starting around 7 p.m.

name: Palm Springs Pride Parade
blurb: The free 'Be Heard' Pride parade steps off at 9:30 a.m. down palm-lined Palm Canyon Drive as the centerpiece of the Nov 6-9 Palm Springs Pride weekend.

name: Doo Dah Takeover ('No Doo Dah Day')
venue: Dog Haus Biergarten, 93 E. Green St.
blurb: With the irreverent Doo Dah Parade on hiatus until 2026, a day of cabaret and Doo Dah Queen tryouts keeps the absurdist tradition alive starting at 11 a.m.

name: Hollywood Christmas Parade (93rd Annual)
blurb: From 6-8 p.m. the Hollywood Boulevard parade features character balloons, marching bands, celebrities, and Santa, with actor Luke Wilson as grand marshal.

name: Official Holiday Tree Lighting
blurb: The city's 22-foot holiday tree is lit at 5:15 p.m., kicking off the Festival of Lights weekend in downtown Palm Springs.

name: Palm Springs Festival of Lights Parade (33rd Annual)
venue: Palm Canyon Drive at Ramon Road
blurb: A nighttime holiday parade beginning at 5:45 p.m. with illuminated floats, marching bands, giant Macy's-style balloons, and Santa Claus down Palm Canyon Drive.

name: California International Marathon
venue: Finish line at the State Capitol
blurb: A point-to-point road marathon starting at 7 a.m. and finishing at the California State Capitol, known as a fast Boston-qualifying course.

name: Newport Beach Christmas Boat Parade (117th Annual)
venue: Newport Harbor, departing from Lido Isle
blurb: Over 100 decorated yachts and boats themed 'Magical Nights of Lights' sail a 14-mile harbor loop each evening around 6:30 p.m., free to watch from shore, with fireworks on opening and closing nights.

name: All Souls Procession and Grand Finale
venue: Downtown Tucson / Barrio Hollywood (Mercado San Agustin area)
blurb: The 36th annual two-mile, human-powered Dia de los Muertos procession culminates Sunday Nov 9 with the ceremonial burning of The Urn.

name: Moab Trail Marathon & Half Marathon
venue: Behind the Rocks / Amasa Back trails, Moab
blurb: A red-rock trail marathon and half-marathon weekend (Nov 8-9) routed through the Behind the Rocks Wilderness with views into Canyonlands.

name: Moab Folk Festival
venue: Star Hall and venues in downtown Moab
blurb: An annual folk-music festival (Nov 7-9) featuring more than ten bands and musicians across downtown Moab.

name: The Polar Express
venue: Williams Depot, Grand Canyon Railway (233 N Grand Canyon Blvd)
blurb: The Grand Canyon Railway's 90-minute Polar Express holiday train runs nightly from Nov 7 through Dec 30, 2025, departing the historic Williams Depot.

name: Moab Turkey Trot 5K
blurb: Moab City's annual Turkey Trot 5K starts at 9 AM on Nov 22 at the MRAC, with a free Kids' K around Swanny Park.

name: Scottsdale Waterfront Art & Light Festival
blurb: A 10-day outdoor art-and-light festival (Nov 7-16) with large-scale installations, workshops, live performances, and food trucks along the Scottsdale Waterfront.

name: Flagstaff Winter Wonderland & Christmas Tree Lighting
blurb: A free Dec 6 celebration (3-6 PM) at Heritage Square with hot cocoa, s'mores, live music, and a tree lighting at 6:15 PM.

name: Zion Joy to the World Light Parade & Sweets Social
venue: SR-9 to Canyon Community Center (126 Lion Blvd)
blurb: Springdale's annual Zion Canyon light parade rolls down SR-9 at 7 PM on Dec 12, ending with a sweets social and photos with the Clauses at the gateway to Zion.

name: Temple Square Christmas Lights
venue: Temple Square, downtown Salt Lake City
blurb: Over one million Christmas lights illuminate Temple Square nightly (4:30-10:00 PM) from Nov 28, 2025 through Jan 1, 2026.

name: Tabernacle Choir Christmas Concert
blurb: The Tabernacle Choir's annual Christmas concert series runs Dec 11-13, 2025, with guest artists Stephanie J. Block and Sebastian Arcelus.

name: Winterhaven Festival of Lights
venue: Historic Winterhaven Neighborhood (Country Club Rd & Fort Lowell Rd)
blurb: Tucson's longest-running holiday tradition lights up more than 200 homes nightly 6-10 PM from Dec 13-27, 2025, with free admission.

name: Park City Mountain Opening Day
venue: Park City Mountain (Park City and Canyons Village bases)
blurb: Utah's largest ski resort opened for the 2025-26 winter season out of both bases on Dec 5, 2025.

name: Phoenix Marathon
blurb: The inaugural Phoenix Marathon on Dec 13 routes runners across the Valley past desert vistas and Papago Park.

name: Noon Year's Eve
blurb: A free family New Year's event (10 AM-noon) at Heritage Square on Dec 31 with crafts, cookie decorating, and a midday pinecone drop and cider toast.
